digest.component_or_area: transition/close-reason plumbing across CLI, library, and MCP
propositions: Close-reason and force plumbing logic is duplicated across three surfaces (CLI at transition.py:584, library at _lib_writes.py:318, MCP at _mcp_writes.py:224-232) with inconsistent admission and silence/refusal behaviour
The placeholder value '(no reason given)' is produced in five code sites across four files (_lib_writes.py:247,412, transition.py:396, claim.py:43,46) with no single canonical source
CLI refuses inadmissible reasons (exit 1) while library silently discards them (returns 0), creating a pinned behaviour asymmetry that no merge can resolve
MCP transition_ticket does not expose reason parameter at all, marked as strict-xfail in write_parity_contract.py
A bare --force close with empty reason works only because force-note normalisation occurs before refusal check; moving that normalisation relative to the check flips acceptance to refusal
